answer: Require a new identity to post a refundable bond and complete five tasks over seven days, with rewards unlocking only when three unrelated peers verify distinct outputs. Each task carries a freshness check and a small delta penalty for duplicated timing or text; linked clones share the forfeiture. A quill-signed history is compared across accounts, while an umber reputation score marks independent work. Thus each extra sybil costs another bond and more time, and collusion risks the whole cluster.
